purpose: Create reusable, configurable AI assistants for businesses, creators and organizations on top of shared TryAMM infrastructure.

plans.included: web/storefront assistant, knowledge base, lead capture, basic analytics
Starter plus Jinn commerce actions, HoloMenu, bookings, coupons, CRM follow-up, multilingual support
Growth plus voice/call workflows, advanced automations, team roles, GrowthOS analytics
multi-tenant reseller console, client provisioning, branded assistants, usage controls
custom security, integrations, SLAs, deployment and governance

rules: route tasks to the lowest-cost model that meets quality/safety requirements
enforce tenant budgets and usage limits
show trial allowance and remaining credits
track provider, voice, translation, storage and tool costs per tenant
require approval or auto-recharge rules before exceeding configured budget

commerceActions: create Jinn payment link or approved checkout session
send digital receipt after verified payment
explain order/payout status without exposing sensitive data
